sql: with f as (select fl.market_ticker, split_part(fl.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, min(fl.filled_at) as filled_at, min(lo.created_at) as placed_at from fills fl join live_orders lo on lo.kalshi_order_id=fl.kalshi_order_id where lo.strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and lo.side='no' and lo.action='buy' and lo.limit_price between 90 and 95 group by 1,2), p as (select distinct on (market_ticker) market_ticker, realized_pnl, coalesce(quantity_fp,quantity) as pos from positions order by market_ticker, captured_at desc), w as (select f.*, extract(epoch from (filled_at-placed_at))/60.0 as wait_min, p.realized_pnl, p.pos, case when series in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION') then 'win7' else 'other' end as grp from f join p using (market_ticker) where p.pos=0) select grp, case when wait_min<1 then 'a <1m' when wait_min<5 then 'b 1-5m' when wait_min<30 then 'c 5-30m' when wait_min<120 then 'd 30-120m' else 'e 2h+' end as wait, count(*) as mkts, sum(case when realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) as losers, round(sum(case when realized_pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end)::numeric*100/count(*),1) as loss_pct from w group by 1,2 order by 1,2
